steps.title: Read the Beta trust boundary
steps.do: Open the Beta scope and reference-profile links before installing the recipe. Confirm that the case is synthetic and the connector is supported only in the configured reference shape.

steps.title: Admit the evidence-review run
steps.do: Install the governed evidence-review recipe and start it as the project-A editor. Inspect the run until it is waiting for approval with one request_missing_document proposal.

steps.title: Observe the approval refusal
steps.do: As the initiating editor, try to approve the protected proposal. Confirm the project_role_required refusal and that the downstream ledger is still empty.

steps.title: Approve and resume
steps.do: Sign in as the distinct approver, inspect the exact proposal diff, approve it, then resume the run as the configured operator.

steps.title: Verify the single effect
steps.do: Confirm completed and accepted, then read the receipt and Harborlight case. The case is version 2 and the downstream ledger contains exactly one document request.

steps.title: Inspect causal evidence
steps.do: Open the run evidence and audit trail. Confirm the run, proposal, approval, decision, receipt and downstream request ids are linked with no missing or unrecorded links.

steps.title: Export and replay
steps.do: Download the exact evidence export and replay it offline. Confirm matched and verify that the downstream mutation count remains one.

steps.title: Check isolation and stale recovery
steps.do: Switch to project B and confirm the run is not readable. Submit a stale If-Match request only to demonstrate the 412 refusal; refresh the case before a legitimate retry.
